purpose: Generator method acquisition retains its receiver until completion; generic iterator mode discards an owning return before the parent tail and sends a named snapshot with defaults.
source:
<?php
class AcquiredMethodA15 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class AcquiredMethodR15 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class AcquiredMethodAggregate15 implements IteratorAggregate {
    function getIterator(): Traversable {
        echo "GET|";
        try { yield "item" => new AcquiredMethodA15(); echo "N|"; return new AcquiredMethodR15(); }
        finally { echo "L|"; }
    }
    function __destruct() { echo "Q|"; }
}
function acquiredMethodGenerator15() {
    echo "G|";
    try { $result = yield from new AcquiredMethodAggregate15(); echo "AFTER|", $result === null ? "NULL|" : "BAD|"; }
    finally { echo "F|"; }
}
function acquiredMethodTarget15($head = 17, $item = null) { echo "D|", $head, "|"; $item = null; echo "X|"; }
echo "P|";
acquiredMethodTarget15(...acquiredMethodGenerator15());
echo "E";

purpose: Temporary acquired child finalization precedes parent finally; the copied current and sent value retire in their distinct order, with no invented Generator API trace.

    finally { echo "L|"; }
}
class AcquiredKeyAggregate15 implements IteratorAggregate {
    function getIterator(): Traversable { echo "GET|"; return acquiredKeyChild15(); }
    function __destruct() { echo "Q|"; }
}
function acquiredKeyGenerator15() { echo "G|"; try { yield from new AcquiredKeyAggregate15(); } finally { echo "F|"; } }

echo "P|";
